notes: The prompt asks in Arabic for a 3D football map with a pitch, people, and a ball to kick, so it is Sports even though the answers strip out teams, rules and scoring — the space wanted is still a marked football pitch, which is space-bounded, and the goals and markings come from Field Sport. I dropped the preset's play boundary and kickoff spot because the answer says there is no match to reset or start, and kept trigger-scoring only for the goal geometry itself rather than any point detection; that leaves the preset recognisable by its shape, which is why I kept the name. I read the source's people as ambient figures kicking about on the pitch and covered them with npc-population, since that request is in the prompt even though the intake answers never touched it. The stadium look is a clean grass pitch only — the answer twice asks for simple, so no stands were added and nothing here leaves P0.
